question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words/phrase.**

Spoken or done without preparation
solution:
The correct answer is: **Extempore**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Extempore **means something done or spoken without preparation. (बिना तैयारी के कुछ किया या बोला गया)
 
• It is a type of speech or performance given on the spot, without any prior planning or rehearsal.
 
• Extempore speeches are often used in debates, public speaking competitions, and other similar events.
 
• The word comes from the Latin phrase "**ex tempore**," which means "**out of time**."

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Elocution **refers to the art of public speaking, particularly in terms of pronunciation, intonation, and gesture. (सार्वजनिक रूप से बोलने की कला, विशेष रूप से उच्चारण, स्वर और हावभाव के संदर्भ में)
 
• **Debate **is a structured argument between two or more people, with each side presenting their own arguments and trying to convince the other side of their position. (दो या दो से अधिक लोगों के बीच एक संरचित तर्क, जिसमें प्रत्येक पक्ष अपने-अपने तर्क प्रस्तुत करता है और दूसरे पक्ष को अपनी स्थिति समझाने की कोशिश करता है)
 
• **Declamation** is a type of speech or performance that is meant to be dramatic or impassioned, often involving recitation of poetry or other literary works. (एक प्रकार का भाषण या प्रदर्शन जो नाटकीय या भावपूर्ण होता है, जिसमें अक्सर कविता या अन्य साहित्यिक कार्यों का पाठ शामिल होता है)
